name: engineering
description: Reusable engineering skills and bounded review-fix loops for OpenAI Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, build, verify, review, and communicate software.
interface.longDescription: Reusable Agent Skills centered on observable outcomes, test-first feedback, clear communication, evidence, bounded review loops, material decisions, and human escalation.
defaultPrompt: Implement this change and verify it.
Explain this engineering update clearly for its audience.
Create a verified user guide for this product behavior.
Use $engineering:handoff to prepare a continuation handoff for the next agent.
Review the current change for defects.
Use $engineering:acceptance-verify to QA this user journey with browser evidence.
Use $engineering:bugfix-loop to prove and fix this bug with regression evidence.
Use $engineering:delivery-loop to deliver this feature in approved worktrees through bounded agent delegation and independent review.
